f2007.notes: Ferrari F2007 is an open-wheel Formula 1 car with a dedicated central rear rain lamp and no authored front lamps. Disable the Lotus donor's phantom headlights and road illuminator while retaining the native handles.

mcl_f1gtr.notes: BODY_H material mcl_f1gtr_ext: centers of the inner red circular rear lenses, measured from source geometry/UVs and verified against rear source views. Outer amber lenses and lower bumper reflectors are excluded. No dedicated reverse lamp is present.

mcl_senna.notes: BODY_H material mcl_senna_lights: centers of the two narrow upper rear strips, each a 36-position surface component. Red bumper reflectors at Y 0.405 are excluded. The separate low central white lamp component supplies the reverse anchor.

mcl_sennagtr.notes: BODY_H material mcl_sennagtr_lights: centers of the two narrow upper rear strips, each a 36-position surface component. Two separate lower four-position lamp components supply the reverse anchors.
